content: Nkɔɔr a mbuur aŋàkwɛkà
Yɛsu kàbilà u bwaar, waa kàfàsabà ɛwà ntɔn mukyà bul ande.
Apan bun'twääl mbuur mwɛy wàŋàkwɛkà wàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n udu a ipɔy. Umpal kàmɛn Yɛsu làkwikilà aba, nde kàtɛn a mbuur aŋàkwɛkà naa: « Mwan amɛ, sà un'kanà! Bàmadwääl nkul a man'be angye! »
Wɛɛ alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: « Mbuur wà an'bɛy Nzam! »
Yɛsu kàkyer ayöb an'kyän aba, waa kàtɛn naa: « Ntɔn nkye làwe bɛ anà an'kyän an'be u mpem abɛ?
Nkye byan'söön ubwaŋ, mutɛn naa: "Ube angye ban'wà", lɛɛ mutɛn naa: "Mbarà, kyen"?
Yà ubwaŋ naa bɛ, bɛ làyöb naa Mwan a mbuur we anà ikɔ̈b adwääl baar nkul u mɛɛn pà. » Apan, nde kàtɛn a mbuur aŋàkwɛkà naa: « Mɛ amaswaŋ: Mbarà, sɛn ipɔy angye, furà ndwà angye! »
Mbuur awun waa kàmbarà, waa kàkyen ndwà ande.
Mpal kyàmɛn iköŋ a baar ndaa ayi, kya kyàkäl u bɔɔmà, waa kyàkömà Nzam ntɔn kàpɛ nde ikɔ̈b atub aki akà baar.
Yɛsu kan'bel Màtay

Ungö apan, Yɛsu waa kàkyen. Mpal kàkäl nde mulyaŋ, nde kàmɛn mbuur mwɛy kàkyàbwaay kà ikal bàfàfur itɛr, ikɔb ande Màtay. Nde kàtɛn a nde naa: « Yan'läb! » Mbuur awà waa kàmbarà, waa kun'läb.
Yɛsu kàkäl mudyà u ndwà. Afüür a itɛr mbɔɔn anà baar abe bàyàdyà mɛsà mwɛy anà Yɛsu anà alɔŋki ande.
Mpal bàmɛn Amfarisi abun, ba bàfuul alɔŋki ande naa: « Ntɔn nkye Un'lɔɔŋ abɛ udyaa nde ikal imwɛy anà afüür a itɛr anà baar abe? »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu, mpal kàwem nde abwɛy, nde kàtɛn naa: « Mfun a ungaŋ yatɛy akà baar mpa abye anà ukyal, wɛɛ akà abɛy.
Abun, làkyen kàlalɔŋkà mbuul a ndaa yi: "Mɛ, mɛ in'kwen nsyääm, wɛɛ kà ibɔɔn anki." Ntɔn mɛ, mɛ kàyi anki mubel baar a balàbal, wɛɛ baar abe. »
Yɛsu anà ukin mbɔr
Apan, alɔŋki a Ywan bàyi apà Yɛsu, waa bun'fuul naa: « Ntɔn nkye bi anà Amfarisi, bi ifàkin udyà, wɛɛ alɔŋki angye bàfàkin anki udyà? »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Nkye asam a mbuur kan'tà bɔr ban'kwo bàkäl u ngyɛb umpal awà nde apà ba? Wɛɛ ilä ikyer asàyà bàsun'lwom ba uboboo a ba, apan ba bàsàkin udyà. »
« Akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mubaay ipfɛy aŋànün anà ikaam a ipfɛy akün, ntɔn kya iyàkaam ipfɛy aŋànün, abun tuun a ipfɛy làyàbulà làkölàköl.
Vin akün bàfàsà anki u mbeen aŋànün manà mbeen iyàbölà, manà man iyàpää anà mbeen iyàkyà bwà. Wɛɛ vin akün bàfàsà u mbeen akün, waa vin anà mbeen byàsàkal aŋàtii ubwaŋ. »
Mwan a mfum a un'yudà wun'kaar anà un'kaar kàtɛ ipfɛy a Yɛsu mpi.

Umpal kàtɛɛnà Yɛsu a ba abà, un'byääl mwɛy kàyàbwà an'köm kusà a nde, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mwan amɛ wà un'kaar kan'kwà itaan a mbɔɔn tɛy. Wɛɛ yun'si an'kɔɔ, waa nde ufàyàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈. »
Apan, Yɛsu waa kàmbarà, waa kun'läb anà alɔŋki ande.
Taaŋ nsil alan, un'kaar mwɛy awàkàyitoo an'kil mbul kwem aŋiyweel, kàyàsin tsütsü ungö a Yɛsu, waa kàtɛ làpaan a ipfɛy ande mpi.
Ntɔn nde kàtɛɛnà naa: « Isàkal naa mɛ an'tà làpaan a ipfɛy ande mpi, mɛ in'kyer akɔɔrà. »
Mpal kàbulà Yɛsu anà kun'mɛn nde, nde kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mwan amɛ, sà un'kanà! Làkwikilà angye làmakɔɔr. » Taaŋ nsil alan, un'kaar awà waa kàkɔɔrà.
Umpal kàkɔlà Yɛsu u ndwà a un'byääl awà anà kàmɛn nde abɛɛrà a mfuŋ anà mini a iköŋ a baar,
nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làlwomà, ntɔn mwan un'kaar ŋàkwà tɛy, nde wàmubɔ̈ɔ̈n. » Wɛɛ ba waa bun'sɛɛ.
Ungö bàtwey ba iköŋ a baar, nde waa kàbilà, kàtɛ kɔɔ a mwan un'kaar awun mpi, mwan un'kaar waa kàwiyà.
Làsaŋ a ndaa ayi làkyer apää kun'tà awun.
Nkɔɔr a ikwàmii abɔ̈ɔ̈l
Umpal kàkyen Yɛsu, ikwàmii abɔ̈ɔ̈l waa bàyun'labà bàmuyisà in'kwɛŋ: « Mwan a David, iweem ngyɛb! »
Umpal kàbilà nde u ndwà, ikwàmii bàyàsin tsütsü apà nde, waa Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Nkye bɛ lan'sà làkwikilà naa mɛ an'kwo in'kyer ya? » Ba bun'fuur naa: « Inye, Mwol. »
Apan, Yɛsu waa kàbä mii aba, waa kàtɛn naa: « Wɛy ya ikäl asànaa alà làkwikilà abɛ! »
Waa mii aba myàyaanà. Yɛsu kaswɛŋ a ngwal naa: « Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ, wɛy akà mbuur mwɛy ukɔɔn ayöb! »
Wɛɛ ba, pa làtoo, laa bàpay ba làsaŋ ande u nsi yanswà.
Nkɔɔr a nkiin mwɛy
Umpal bàkäl ba mukyà, baar bun'twääl nkiin mwɛy kàkäl anà unsɔŋà.
Pa kàböŋ Yɛsu unsɔŋà awun, nkiin waa kàsɛmà musà ndaa. In'kàbɔ a baar bàmɛn ndaa yubem, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Ndaa atub ayi ŋàtàbwà anki kà Isàlɛl. »
Wɛɛ Amfarisi bàtɛn naa: « Nde an'dweelà an'be ayiböŋ unsà ikɔ̈b a mfum a an'dweelà an'be. »
Yɛsu anà in'sɛŋ a baar
Yɛsu kàyilyaŋà kà an'bul a kölàköl anà mà ikikye. Nde kàyilɔɔŋà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà aba, mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Imwol a du anà mukɔɔr ukyal banswà anà too lanswà.
Umpal kàmɛn nde iköŋ a baar, laa kàkyɛɛr nde, ntɔn baar abà bàkäl aŋàyɔn anà ndür aŋàkwamà, asànaa in'kɔk ikɔ̈ɔ̈n un'seey.
Apan nde kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: « Mbɛŋ aŋàsöŋ yà mbɔɔn, wɛɛ baar a isal abwo ya bà ikikye.
Làlɔ̈ɔ̈m akà ŋaywaŋ mutɔm baar a isal mbɔɔn u ywaŋ ande. »
